result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make empathy a universal, involuntary reflex—not just “feeling bad for someone,” but automatically perceiving another person’s inner life as vividly and real as your own.

Most cruelty, indifference, and injustice survive because of distance: “those people,” “not my problem,” “they’re different.” If that distance collapsed, it wouldn’t magically solve every conflict or trade-off, but it would make dehumanization, exploitation, and neglect much harder to sustain. That’s the lever I’d pull.
